name: Green Green
description: At the isolated all-male boarding school of Kanenone Gakuen there are no females for miles but the school board has begun talks to merge with an all-girl boarding school, in hopes of becoming a co-ed boarding school.

episodes.name: Ormanda Heyecan!
episodes.description: Bir kız okulundan bir otobüs dolusu kız, iki okulu entegre etmek için bir aylık deneme çalışması için Kanenone Gakuen'e doğru yola çıktı. Kanenone'de Yuusuke, Baka Trio'nun gözcülük yaptığı bir karşılama partisi hazırlamada çocuklara liderlik eder. Otobüs nihayet geldiğinde, Midori dışarı fırlar, Yuusuke'yi nihayet onunla karşılaşmanın heyecanıyla bayıltır ve "bu sefer" kaderlerini değiştireceklerini ilan eder.

episodes.name: Banyoya Düşmek
episodes.description: Kızlar, Baka Trio'nun maskaralıkları ve Kanenone'deki sade tesisler karşısında dehşete düşerler, ancak buranın açık havada bir kaplıcaya sahip olduğunu keşfettiklerinde neşelenirler. Baka Üçlüsü, banyo yapan kızlara göz kulak olmaya karar verirken, Yuusuke onları durdurma görevini üstlenir.

episodes.name: Hard Times in the Forest
episodes.description: Outraged over a prank pulled on her by the Baka Trio, Futaba decides to leave Kanenone for home. In her search for a short cut to the bus stop, she gets lost in the surrounding forest and injures her ankle. Yuusuke, Midori, and the Baka Trio attempt to find and bring her back to Kanenone.

episodes.name: Kız Yurdunda Sorun
episodes.description: Futaba, Yuusuke'ye karşı hisler beslemeye başladığını fark eder. Midori bunu fark eder ve Futaba konusunda Yuusuke ile yüzleşir. O akşam Baka Üçlüsü (ve isteksiz bir Yuusuke), kızlar uyurken kızların yurduna girmeye çalışır.

episodes.name: Revirde Düşmek
episodes.description: Sanae ilaç kutusunu kaybeder ama Yuusuke onu bulmasına yardım eder. Yaptığı iyilik, ikisini bir araya getirmeye karar veren Reika tarafından görülür ve yanlış yorumlanır; ve Sanae'nin kalbini kazanmanın bir yolunu bulmak için Baka Trio'nun diğer üyelerinin yardımını isteyen kıskanç Tazio tarafından.

episodes.name: Hot Hot in the PE Preparation Room
episodes.description:
"A Steamy Time in the P.E. Equipment Room"

Midori and Yuusuke are assigned to scout for locations for a school affair. Midori decides to treat the assignment as a date, and gets Reika to promise not to interfere. In order to prevent the Baka Trio from getting in the way, Reika locks them inside the PE storage room, where the heat soon causes them to have vivid hallucinations about the girls they desire.

episodes.name: Soaking Wet by the Pool
episodes.description: After repeated failures to win Futaba's heart by following the dubious recommendations of a dating guidebook, Hikaru turns to Midori for help, with the rest of the Baka Trio in tow. Unfortunately, they take her suggestion to put themselves in the girls' position much too literally.

episodes.name: Morning Bath Fuss
episodes.description: Alone in the outdoor bath, Reika delivers a surveillance report on Midori and her attempts to attract the interest of Yuusuke. Soon after "signing off", she is joined by Chigusa-sensei and the rest of the girls. They all talk about their experiences at Kanenone to date, unaware of the presence of the camouflaged Baka Trio.

episodes.name: Hightailing It out of the Test of Courage
episodes.description: Chigusa-sensei organizes a late-night "test of courage", with the boys and girls pairing off. To Midori's dismay, Yuusuke draws Futaba as his partner. Reika sees this as an opportunity to bring Yuusuke and Futaba closer. Meanwhile, the Baka Trio try to take advantage of the girls they were paired with.

episodes.name: Stumbling Around in the Library
episodes.description: After a failed examination, Chigusa-sensei assigns Yuusuke to tutor Midori in the hope of bringing her grades up. As an incentive, she tells Midori that Yuusuke will give her a reward if her test results are above average. Wakaba mishears this, and soon a rumor that getting an above-average test result will allow you to receive a reward from the person you like goes around the entire school.

episodes.name: Kader tarafından bunalmış
episodes.description: Midori'nin tesadüfi bir öpücüğü, Yuusuke'nin geçmiş anılarını ve ona karşı olan hislerini yeniden canlandırır. Yeni kavuşan çift birbirlerini yeniden bulmanın mutluluğunu yaşasa da olayların bu beklenmedik gidişatı Reika, Futaba ve Baka Üçlüsü'nü çok farklı nedenlerle üzer.

episodes.name: Farewell Kanenone Gakuen Academy
episodes.description:
Confused by the memories of his past life and wary of going against fate, Yuusuke decides it is better for him and Midori to remain separated. Upset by Yuusuke's choice, Midori runs off. Yuusuke goes after her, but seriously injures himself when he saves her from a fall over a cliff. Although the pair are found by the Baka Trio and brought back to Kanenone, bad weather prevents Yuusuke from being transferred to a place with better medical facilities.

With Yuusuke's life in the balance, Midori uses her remaining life-force to restore him to health, although she does so at the price of her having to return to her own era. Despite this, she declares her wish to be together again with Yuusuke has come true, as she, through her life-force, will become one with Yuusuke. She and Yuusuke share a final kiss before Reika takes her back to the 31st century.
